class.name: CSGModifier
class.brief_description: Base resource for modifying the generated geometry of a CSG shape.
class.description: A CSG modifier is applied before the render mesh, collision, and navigation geometry are generated. Script-defined attribute modifiers are applied to the result of a [CSGShape3D] after its Boolean operations have completed. Built-in geometry modifiers can run on temporary copies of the shape's operands, on the Boolean result, or at both stages. Modifiers within the same stage are applied in array order. Override [method _process] to implement an attribute modifier in a script. Built-in modifiers can also change the topology of the generated CSG brush.

method.name: _process
method.description: Called when the owning CSG shape rebuilds its geometry. Use [param context] to inspect vertex positions and read or write per-vertex attributes.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this modifier is applied when the owning CSG shape rebuilds.
